scope: Five schematic maze blockouts; design proposal, not Godot implementation.
contract: EVERY floor is a maze. No open-arena substitutes. Numeric logical cells require collision-aware widening during blockout.

mechanics.gate: Collect the unique stage key before gate G opens permanently.
mechanics.shortcut: Lever L is beyond G and opens S permanently; completion works with S closed.
mechanics.exit: Boss B defeated releases exit E. The route to E is navigable once G is unlocked.
mechanics.hazards: H marks suggested optional hazard positions. Safe backbone remains available; final timing requires Godot verification.

floors.name: Rootbound Crown
floors.mood: Granite coronation passages split by dry brown roots, bronze crown reliefs, amber sap lanterns and moss-stained arches.

floors.name: Drowned Bellways
floors.mood: Flooded abbey drainage passages, deep navy wet stone, cyan frost, raised dry ledges, brass bells and blue lanterns.

floors.name: Ember Oathforge
floors.mood: Black furnace brick maze, bronze pipes, ash-white inscriptions, orange vent light and a cobalt cooling-water channel.

floors.name: Windglass Warrens
floors.mood: High mountain observatory partition maze, ivory stone screens, bronze vanes, blue banners, purple storm sky; solid rail-protected floors.

floors.name: Unwritten Labyrinth
floors.mood: Royal archive labyrinth in blue-black stone, silver path inscriptions, angular violet crystal lamps and barred views of a broken throne.
